description: This file defines a React component named ResizeHandler that manages resizing behavior for a Plotly chart within a web application. It adjusts layout, axis tick marks, and visibility of the modebar based on window dimensions.

methods.name: ResizeHandler
methods.description: A React component that dynamically adjusts Plotly chart layout and modebar visibility based on window size, modifying axis tick counts, trace opacities, and layout margins.
